sloka: प्रतिप्रयाते काकुत्स्थे महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः ।अब्रवीत् परमप्रीतो राघवं प्राञ्जलिं स्थितम् ।। ६.१२३.१ ।।
transliteration: pratiprayāte kākutsthe mahendraḥ pākaśāsanaḥ ।abravīt paramaprīto rāghavaṁ prāñjaliṁ sthitam ।। 6.123.1 ।।

translations.english: Mahendra, the tamer of demon Paka, spoke very affectionately to Rama, who stood with joined palms before Dasharatha who had returned.
